messages:
maria: quick note — ran the private/VPC metrics export test with a customer-like workload and saw a 12-18% token-latency regression when the remote_export shim was enabled. filing details below.
cheng: can you paste the profile + which commit?
maria: repro on commit `main@4b2d9` + dedicated shim image `metrics-shim:v0.3.1`. profile (sampled CPU, 30s) shows per-token breakdown: scheduling: 9%, token-parse: 6%, kv-cache lookup: 12%, kernel-exec: 58%, post-serialize/copy: 15%. interestingly kernel-exec p95 is up ~25ms on 512-seq.
sam: that sounds like either kernel selection is picking an unfriendly kernel for short sequences or we're hitting an extra memcpy path in the shim. any stack traces?
maria: stack snippet from perf tool: 
```
runtime_scheduler -> run_batch -> kernel_selector::select -> gpu_kernel_launch -> memcpy_async -> kernel_exec
```
We see more memcpy_async calls in the private path (shim introduces an extra buffer step)
elena: fwiw for air-gapped customers we proposed a file-export fallback (tarball + signed manifest) — that had no shim but was reusing the same exporter API. Does the regression show up there?
maria: no regression on tarball flow. only when using remote_write over the shim connector.
praveen: ok sounds like the shim is doing a copy/aggregation step that doesn't use zero-copy with our runtime. two approaches: 1) change shim to use mmap/posix memfd zero-copy when in same host netns, 2) change runtime to expose an export fd where exporter can stream without copy.
ach4: @alex (cc @cheng) — can you validate if the kernel selector falls back to `small_seq_generic` for these customers? That would explain higher kernel-exec time on 512-seq.
alex: I looked; kernel selector metric `kernel_variant_chosen` shows variant `vectorized_generic` 70% of time in hosted, but in private/VPC it's `vectorized_generic` 40% + `fallback_small` 50%. The shim adds ~2ms overhead per request in the hot path and seems to flip an internal heuristic (sequence_len reported differently).
cheng: sequence length reported differently? how?
alex: shim was trimming trailing whitespace (trying to normalize) and we compute effective sequence length from tokenization metadata in the exporter header. the shim stripped a trailing newline which made short sequences look one token shorter so selector chose a smaller kernel that performed worse at these sizes.
sam: ouch. that's a nasty edge-case. two prongs: fix shim normalization and make kernel selector robust to +/-1 token noise. Also we should surface per-route token-length histograms in the Grafana dashboards for private customers so we can spot this quickly.
elena: for private customers we need to keep PII out of metrics — proposal: exporter only emits aggregated length histograms and quantile summaries with customer_id label redacted to hash. remote_write shim should have a config flag `redact_labels=true` and `max_buckets=50`. Example config snippet: 
```
remote_export:
  remote_write_url: https://metrics-inbound.local
  redact_labels: true
  allowed_metrics: ["token_latency_seconds_bucket","kernel_variant_chosen"]
  max_buckets: 50
```
That avoids sending raw prompt tokens.
praveen: agree. also add an option to emit per-route `token_latency_breakdown` as separate counters: `scheduling_ms`, `kv_lookup_ms`, `kernel_ms`, `serialize_ms`. Then in hosted/console we compose them into stacks, but in private we export the raw counters.
maria: I pushed a minimal patch to shim to stop normalizing whitespace: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2314 (details in ticket). running new image `metrics-shim:v0.3.2-wn` now — preliminary test shows kernel-exec p95 back to baseline.
acheng: nice. can we add an instrumentation TODO: emit a `{route,customer_tier,kernel_variant}` label on token histograms so ops can filter per-route KPIs? keep `customer_id` hashed.
sam: yes but keep cardinality low. use `route` for high-level grouping (api.chat, api.generate), don't export raw model names.
elena: for air-gapped fallback we should provide a small agent that runs on the appliance and writes Prometheus-format files to a mounted dir; customer Grafana can scrape via file_sd. This avoids network egress. add doc snippet to private-deploy README.
ops-bot: deploybot: metrics-shim:v0.3.2-wn promoted to staging at 2026-03-18T15:10Z :rocket: (ci passed)
alex: plan for next steps: 1) merge shim whitespace change (INF-2314) 2) add kernel selector tolerance for +/-1 token (INF-2315) 3) add `token_latency_breakdown` counters + per-route histograms (INF-2316) 4) docs and example Grafana panels for private customers (INF-2317). I'll take 1 & 2, @praveen take 3, @elena take 4.
praveen: taking INF-2316. will instrument counters and push an initial dashboard JSON for review.
maria: thanks all. ping me if you want the full perf traces. :thumbsup:
cheng: closing loop — great catch, shim tests added to our CI to run a 2k request microbenchmark against shim in both tarball and remote_write modes.
